title: Point every check at its own unit
statement: Before checking a unit, confirm the grade, subject and reference files the check uses are that unit's own, since a check pointed at another unit's says nothing about this one.
example: Checked against a replaced unit's files, every passage would have shown a 100% mismatch.
detail: A Grade 5 adversarial review found that its brief cited the canonical files of the unit's superseded subject; comparing the rebuilt literary unit against them would have produced a 100% spurious mismatch on every passage and claim, so the run used the unit's current design source instead. A convergence review of a Grade 3 reading grader found its grade hardcoded to 11, carried over from AP US History.

evidence.quote: Comparing the new literary content against the geology canonical files would produce a 100% spurious mismatch on every passage and every claim (different characters, different subject matter, different vocabulary). That is not a useful canon-fidelity check.
Verified in-repo: production serves on the cheap Gemini judge, grade hardcoded 11 from AP US History
- **Codex caught MY lens lying** (tail-replace URL bug made every page-check run on the arrival page — a false 15/15 clean). Lens now builds paths and asserts the landed page id.
